role: differential auditor: worktree registrations and repository roots
verdict: FAIL: seven confirmed code-defect classes plus one reproduced lock-policy mismatch. Twenty registration states agree across all three receipt surfaces, but ten states produce false SAFE receipts (one is the lock-policy case). Two additional repo-root states contradict between the verifiers, and a gitfile main root receives an invalid pushed receipt. Fresh fixture-only end-to-end proofs demonstrate unsafe worktree deletion and loss of a unique detached commit after the authorized metadata prune and garbage collection.

findings.title: Detached uniqueness check excludes its own linked-worktree HEAD
findings.fresh_reproduction: bash /var/tmp/souji-r9-s11.ghLpKN/reproduce.sh; W04 segment (self-contained script embedded below)
findings.observed: On Git 2.55.0, rev-list P --not --all counts 0 because --all includes linked-worktree HEADs. Explicit refs-only exclusion counts 1; --single-worktree P --not --all also counts 1. Both verifiers still emit SAFE(metadata-prune), and Q emits SKIPPED. Fixture-only git worktree prune --expire now followed by git gc --prune=now makes cat-file -e P^{commit} fail with exit 128. The private.txt blob was present before the prune.
findings.head: c4ace32e36fe2105dff95ca14249a696578e0cd5
findings.scope_limit: Quarantine does not itself execute metadata prune; the demonstrated commit loss follows the SAFE metadata-prune recommendation plus native Git prune and fixture-only garbage collection.
findings.fix_direction: Exclude the candidate registration from reachability comparison; --single-worktree fixes this demonstrated case. Validate object resolution and command success before crediting zero. Amend the binding spec as well as both engines.

findings.title: Git evaluation errors are converted to zero commits and a SAFE receipt
findings.fresh_reproduction: Embedded reproduce.sh W10-W13 segments create absent registrations with nonexistent object, dangling named ref, missing HEAD, and malformed HEAD respectively.
findings.observed: All four states produce SAFE(metadata-prune) in A/B/Q stage 1. W10 reports head=ffffffffffff; W11-W13 report head=000000000000. git log on the unresolved object/ref fails, but piping through wc -l with || true produces 0. Q then returns SKIPPED with exit 0.
findings.fix_direction: Resolve HEAD and branch to valid commit objects; preserve Git exit statuses separately from counts; any resolution/log failure must refuse rather than issue metadata-prune.

findings.title: Last-writer path map masks an unpushed registration
findings.fresh_reproduction: Embedded reproduce.sh W16 creates a-private and z-shared admin records for the same path; W17 creates the same path under owner-shokunin and z-owner-shokunin.
findings.observed: Both verifiers and Q stage 1 choose only the later shared registration and return SAFE(metadata-prune), despite an earlier named unpushed branch. Removing just the shadowing admin record in W16, or restricting SHOKUNIN_ROOT to the first owner in W17, changes A to NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch) with unpushed=1.
findings.scope_limit: No commit deletion claimed for these two cases; the confirmed defect is bypass of the mandatory named-unpushed registration refusal.
findings.fix_direction: Store all registrations for a canonical target and refuse ambiguity, or require all associated registrations and owners to pass independently.

findings.title: Tab-delimited internal metadata corrupts owner identity
findings.fresh_reproduction: Embedded reproduce.sh W19 uses owner basename $'owner\tname-shokunin' and an absent target whose branch has one unpushed commit.
findings.observed: A/B/Q emit SAFE(metadata-prune) with evidence head=name-shokuni owner=owner. A literal tab inside the owner path shifts owner/head/branch fields, making Git queries fail; failures then become zero. Renaming only the fixture owner to owner-normal-shokunin changes the verdict to NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch), unpushed=1.
findings.fix_direction: Use separate associative maps or a lossless record representation, and refuse unsupported control characters before parsing. Independently fail closed on Git errors.

findings.title: Unscanned linked-worktree root falls through to stale and is deleted
findings.fresh_reproduction: Embedded reproduce.sh W20 creates owner/.scratch/linked, registers refs/heads/private, populates its index and committed files, writes untracked active.txt, ages the directory, probes all engines, then invokes quarantine --hold 0.
findings.observed: Census sees two worktrees and flags dirty,unpushed,scratch,wt-dirty. A/B scan only *-shokunin owners, miss the legitimate owner basename owner, and return SAFE(stale) for the dirty linked-worktree root. Q does not inspect nested worktree dirt; the target is untracked in the main repo. It moves the directory, returns SAFE(stale) again from quarantine, passes the second check, and deletes it with exit 0. active.txt has no surviving staged copy.

proof.quarantine_stage4: PASS pin=ok mtime=ok class=stale-via-prong1 prong1=SAFE(stale) binding

findings.fix_direction: Recognize any Git worktree root independently of fleet scanner naming, including .git gitfiles. Unknown owners must refuse, never fall through to pushed/stale artifact receipts. Quarantine must independently refuse nested repositories/worktree roots and inspect their tracked and untracked work before staging.

findings.title: Legacy root preservation receipts accept copies destroyed by source removal
findings.fresh_reproduction: Embedded reproduce.sh R04 uses source==vault with matching current directory digests; R06 stores the backup inside source/.git/backup-copy, which the source digest prunes.
findings.observed: A issues SAFE(moved-to-obsidian) for both. B correctly returns NOT-VERIFIED(source-equals-vault) and NOT-VERIFIED(vault-inside-source). Q stage 1 delegates to A and repeats SAFE for both, but its target-is-repo-root authorization gate correctly blocks the final operation.
findings.scope_limit: No repo-root deletion is claimed. The defect is A's false preservation receipt and the cross-verifier contradiction; Q's downstream root refusal is a successful safety boundary.
findings.fix_direction: Unify the preservation authority, or port B's canonical source-equality and vault-descendant checks into A before any ledger receipt.

findings.title: A real main repository with a gitfile is misclassified as an artifact
findings.fresh_reproduction: Embedded reproduce.sh R05 initializes a main repository with git init --separate-git-dir, supplies pushed remote-tracking refs but no ledger, and probes its root.
findings.observed: Both verifiers return SAFE(pushed) for the repository root, bypassing the root-only-moved-to-obsidian rule. Census emits only its header because .git is a file. Q refuses before stage 1 with exit 2, correctly failing closed.
findings.scope_limit: Census omission is a coverage observation, not an unsafe deletion; Q refusal is not counted as a defect.
findings.fix_direction: Identify the repository root using validated Git top-level/common-dir identity rather than .git directory shape. Main gitfile roots without preservation receipts must refuse.

policy_findings.title: Locked registration receives a metadata-prune SAFE receipt
policy_findings.fresh_reproduction: Embedded reproduce.sh W14 creates an absent shared registration with an admin locked file, probes it, then runs native fixture-only git worktree prune --expire now.
policy_findings.observed: A/B/Q stage 1 say SAFE(metadata-prune); Git itself preserves the locked admin record. The existing lane scorecard explicitly claims lock-preserve for pinned registrations. The literal verifier spec omits locks, so this is separated from the seven strict code-defect classes.
policy_findings.fix_direction: Make lock preservation explicit in the receipt spec and return NOT-SAFE for locked registrations; do not infer authorization from unique=0 alone.

supplemental_observations.observation: Target directory exists and its own status reports ?? active.txt, but census flags wt-absent and not wt-dirty because worktree --porcelain paths are parsed by newline rather than NUL.
Census reports worktrees=2, unpushed=1 and dirty,unpushed,scratch,wt-dirty for the same owner whose linked worktree A/B/Q classify SAFE(stale); actual deletion confirmed under F05.
Census default scan omits a genuine main repository whose .git is a gitfile. No false SAFE result is emitted by census.

not_reproduced_and_correct_refusals: W18 final private-branch newline state: destructive stale bypass NOT-REPRODUCED. count_live_refs returns unknown and all receipt surfaces refuse. Do not count the refusal as a defect.
W15 missing gitdir admin file: registration is not resolvable to the target and all three surfaces return NOT-SAFE(unreachable).
R03 independent valid backup: A/B agree SAFE(moved-to-obsidian), while Q correctly blocks repo-root staging. Stricter authorization is not a receipt contradiction.
R04/R06 final quarantine root gate blocks despite false stage-1 receipts; no repo-root deletion claimed.
R05 quarantine preflight refuses the gitfile root with exit 2; this is not an operability defect under fail-closed grading.

coverage_of_assignment.evidence: 20 registration states x 3 primary surfaces, plus 6 repo-root states x 3 and 26 supplemental censuses per final fresh run.

calibration.evidence: 12 strict code-defect false-SAFE states / 33 receipt calls; additionally one lock-policy state / three calls. Twenty-of-twenty cross-tool registration agreement still contains ten unsafe/policy states, proving agreement is insufficient.

operability.evidence: W20 quarantine executes all stages, second-check PASS and DELETED for a dirty worktree with an unpushed branch. W04 receipt authorizes metadata pruning that removes sole retention of a private commit.

engine_surface_coverage.evidence: Unscanned owner names and valid .git gitfile roots bypass root/registration gates.

differential_consistency.evidence: A and B contradict in R04 and R06 (2/26 states); Q inherits A's false receipts. Refused preflights and stricter final root gates are not charged as contradictions.

reproducibility.evidence: Final Python corpus repeated on fresh AG3Ivz and CS40Sa fixture roots with identical verdict/count results. prove.py and independent self-contained reproduce.sh each prove W04 commit loss and W20 deletion. Four installed tool hashes stayed unchanged.

rubric_verdicts.numeric_score_recommendation: Do not mint a numeric improvement score from these audit counts. Preserve the lane's per-axis evidence rubric; removal safety remains red until regression replays pass against corrected tools.

evidence_artifacts.retention_note: Raw fixture outputs are retained under /var/tmp. CS40Sa and mZ2wZV include intentional fixture mutations from the destructive proofs; AG3Ivz retains the pre-proof corpus. The embedded shell lines below preserve reproducibility if temporary artifacts are later cleared.

self_contained_reproduction.instructions: Join script_lines with newline, write that script under a new mktemp -d -p /var/tmp directory, then execute it with bash. All Git mutations and removals occur only under a new /var/tmp/souji-r9-s11-repro.* root created by the script; TOOLS is read-only. The script returns 0 on this pinned vulnerable baseline and prints CONFIRMED markers for both loss scenarios. It is a reproducer, not a green regression test of fixed behavior.
script_lines: for key in ${!GIT_@}; do unset "$key"; done
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='S11 Fixture' GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=s11@fixture.invalid GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='S11 Fixture' GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=s11@fixture.invalid
if [ "$mode" = gitfile ]; then git init -q --initial-branch=main --separate-git-dir="$C/git-admin" "$rr"; else git init -q --initial-branch=main "$rr"; fi
pt=$({ git -C "$rr" ls-tree "$H"; printf '100644 blob %s\tprivate.txt\n' "$blob"; } | git -C "$rr" mktree)
export SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$F" SOUJI_LEDGER="$L" SOUJI_Q_SHOKUNIN_ROOT="$F" SOUJI_Q_LEDGER="$L" SOUJI_VERIFY_BIN="$TOOLS/souji-verify.sh"
local rr=$1 name=$2 target=$3 head=$4 branch=${5:-}
if [ -n "$branch" ]; then printf 'ref: %s\n' "$branch" > "$A/HEAD"; else printf '%s\n' "$head" > "$A/HEAD"; fi
ddigest() { (cd "$1" && find . -path './.git' -prune -o -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); }
if git -C "$R" cat-file -e "$P^{commit}"; then exit 81; else printf 'CONFIRMED W04 private commit lost\n'; fi
